_comment: Accepted high/critical advisories in PRODUCTION dependencies. Read by scripts/audit-prod.js, which runs in CI. Every entry needs a reason and a reviewBy date; the build fails once reviewBy passes, and again if the entry stops matching anything. Do not add an entry to silence a finding that has a patched version available - upgrade instead.

allow.reason: Dev tooling only, never shipped. Sole path is expo > @expo/cli (directly and via @expo/code-signing-certificates), which uses node-forge to read local iOS signing certs for `expo run:ios` and to sign expo-updates manifests in the dev server - no app here configures updates code signing. It is not imported by app code and is absent from the C# API, the Next.js runtime and the compiled RN bundles. Advisory range is '<= 1.4.0' with no patched release; 1.4.0 is the latest.

Build/dev tooling only, never shipped. Sole path is expo > @expo/cli > @expo/metro-file-map > micromatch > braces (also metro-file-map), i.e. the Metro bundler's file watcher, which expands glob patterns from this repo's own config - no untrusted input reaches it. Not imported by app code; absent from the C# API, the Next.js runtime and the compiled RN bundles. Advisory range is '<= 3.0.3' with no patched release; 3.0.3 is the latest.
